title: Entrywise Positivity Preservers on Green Matrices
summary: We classify the entrywise functions that preserve positive semidefiniteness on discrete Green matrices \(G(p,q)=(p_{\min(i,j)}q_{\max(i,j)})\) with positive parameters, without requiring the resulting matrix to retain Green structure. For matrices of all orders, the preservers are the zero function and the functions \(f(t)=\int_{[0,\infty)}t^α\,dμ(α)\), where \(μ\) is a nonzero finite positive measure and the integral is finite for every \(t>0\).
